title: Track every commit-held export of a task since the last import, so incremental task-sync never needs the discarded-write rules
outcome: Track every commit-held export of a task since the last import, so incremental task-sync never needs the discarded-write rules
acceptance: The folder head records the fingerprints of this host's commit-held writes since its last import, and an incoming document equal to any of them is taken as this host's own
The rule that reads a discarded task at its export's base commit is replaced or justified by that record, with a regression for export, commit, export, discard, import, export
